review_text:
Complete Disaster of a Stay. Avoid If You Value Cleanliness or Peace of Mind
If you ever wanted to experience a wildlife sanctuary without leaving your hotel room, this is the place for you! 🪳🐭🪱
The room comes with an exclusive cockroach community, apparently enjoying permanent residency. Meanwhile, mice have taken up the role of hotel management, casually running between the reception and dining area. And for the truly adventurous guest, there are worms happily living in the water collected in the dripping tray of water dispenser placed in dining area. Nature is clearly thriving here more than the guests.
Breakfast is another unforgettable experience. The menu is extremely “minimalist” ... idly, bonda, bread and tea. FYI there's no live counters. And even for this list, you need to wait for each item minimum of 10-15 minutes.
And then comes the hotel’s signature service: WAITING.
We locked our room and went for breakfast, that the door got jammed. Even the master keys couldn’t open it. So, naturally, we were treated to an unexpected 45 minutes waiting session, until a carpenter finally arrived to rescue us.
At this point, I’m not sure whether I stayed at a hotel or participated in an escape-room challenge.
I booked this room based on its ratings, but honestly, it was nowhere near worth the rating or the money we paid.
To summarise:
🪳 Cockroaches: 5-star accommodation
🐭 Mice: Excellent freedom of movement
🪱 Worms: Water facility residents
🍽️ Breakfast: Limited edition
🔑 Room access: Advanced puzzle
⏳ Service speed: Please bring patience
😂 Entertainment: Unbeatable
If you’re looking for a clean, comfortable and hassle-free hotel stay, look elsewhere.

review_text:
I stayed at IK London Hotel near AIG, Somajiguda, Hyderabad.
First, I would like to appreciate the gentleman at the reception. He was extremely polite, gentle, and well-mannered, and his professionalism was commendable.
However, the room cleanliness needs significant improvement. Although the room appeared to be cleaned, there were many small cockroaches on the towels, bed, chair, and even in the bathroom. This was very disappointing and unacceptable.
The most upsetting experience was at the hotel restaurant during lunch on 21st July. I asked the waiter, Ramesh, about the available vegetable dishes. He informed me that paneer was available, but I specifically ordered only Jeera Aloo, buttermilk, and papad. He handed me the menu, and at no point did I order Mix Veg.
Later, another staff member came to reconfirm my order and mentioned that I had ordered Mix Veg along with Jeera Aloo, buttermilk, and papad. I immediately clarified that I had never ordered Mix Veg. I was dining alone and could not possibly finish two full vegetable dishes.
Instead of correcting the mistake, Ramesh insisted that I had ordered both dishes and said that since they had already prepared them, I had to accept both. His behavior was rude, unprofessional, and disrespectful.
I had to approach the reception to report the incident.
We chose this hotel because one of the doctors at AIG Hospital recommended it. My husband had undergone surgery and was in the ICU, and I came to the restaurant hoping to have a peaceful lunch during a very stressful time. Being treated so disrespectfully by a staff member was deeply upsetting.
While the rest of the staff were courteous, one employee's behavior can significantly affect a guest's overall experience. Hospitality is not just about providing accommodation and food—it is about treating guests with respect.
We had planned to stay here for four more days, but after this experience, we have decided not to continue our stay. Even if it means walking a little farther to reach AIG Hospital, I would rather choose a place where guests are treated with dignity and respect.

Before booking, please understand that this is an inn, not a hotel. An inn offers basic facilities and limited services, while a hotel usually provides more comfort and full-service hospitality. If you keep this difference in mind, your expectations will be realistic.
We booked a three-person occupancy room because the two-person option felt too small. They initially quoted ₹2000+ for an AC room, but we negotiated and settled at a better price. Make sure you finalize everything on the spot and take a confirmation slip. Do not leave anything verbal.
The room was okay. Bathroom and geyser were working fine. There was no balcony. There were windows but they could not be opened, and there was no view as another building was right outside. WiFi was very good.
Housekeeping was done whenever we requested bedsheet changes or cleaning. The dustbin was kept outside, and whenever we informed them, they cleared it. So service was manageable.
Food options are easily available nearby. The biggest advantage is that it is just a two-minute walking distance from Yashoda Hospitals, which makes it very convenient for patients and attendants.
Right in front of this inn, there is a big hotel where we inquired for one day and the tariff was around ₹6000. So you can compare and decide what suits your budget and comfort level.
I do not know about other occupancy types or rooms. I am only sharing my experience with the room we stayed in. I heard that the top floor rooms have a common balcony, but we did not stay there.
This place is fine if you understand what an inn offers. Suitable for couples and people who are okay with non-veg surroundings. Elderly guests might find it a bit suffocating. Not recommended for long stays. We stayed for 7 days, and that was enough.
Hope this helps future visitors decide better.

Electricity was unavailable throughout the entire night, which was not just inconvenient but also raised serious safety concerns. The staff seemed indifferent and only asked for money in advance, ignoring all guest complaints.
The property does not provide food, and it was extremely hard to find healthy or safe food options nearby. Additionally, a dalal (middleman) near the property seemed dangerous and untrustworthy — guests should be very careful.

review_text:
I recently stayed at **OYO 29928 Sai Manikanta Residency**, and my experience was genuinely satisfying. This property is one of the best budget-friendly stays in the Punjagutta area, especially for travelers who want comfort, convenience, and good service at an affordable price. The biggest advantage of this hotel is its **excellent location** — it is very close to the **Punjagutta Metro Station**, which makes commuting around Hyderabad extremely easy. Whether you’re traveling for work, shopping, or sightseeing, this location adds great value to your stay.
The room pricing is also very reasonable. A **Non-AC room costs ₹1500**, and an **AC room is ₹1700**, which is quite fair considering the location and the amenities provided. The rooms are clean, well-maintained, and spacious enough for both solo travelers and couples. The beds are comfortable, and the bathrooms are kept hygienic with regular cleaning. The staff here is polite, responsive, and always ready to assist with any requests, making the stay even more pleasant.
Check-in and check-out were smooth, and the overall property feels safe and secure. The surrounding area has plenty of eateries, grocery stores, and transport options, which is a big plus for outstation guests. If you’re looking for a reliable and budget-friendly place near Punjagutta, Sai Manikanta Residency is a great choice. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone planning to stay in this part of Hyderabad.

I had a very disappointing experience at Hotel Sitara Residency. The staff behavior was very poor, and the customer service was extremely unprofessional.
We booked a room in advance and reached the hotel expecting a comfortable stay. However, when we arrived, no one responded properly to our requests. We asked about room options, but the staff did not cooperate or provide any alternatives.
After making the payment, we were given a room that was not satisfactory. When we requested a better room or any other option, the staff did not provide any proper solution. There was no flexibility or willingness to help the customer.
Another major issue was the additional charges for three people. Even though we were charged for three persons, the hotel did not provide an extra bed. We were also charged separately for breakfast for one person.
Overall, the staff's behavior and attitude toward customers were very disappointing. The way they handled our concerns was not what we expected from a hotel.
My family and I do not recommend Hotel Sitara Residency. I would strongly suggest that other travelers carefully check the room, facilities, additional charges, and hotel policies before making payment.

I recently had the pleasure of staying with my family at Neem Tree Apartments at Kapadia Lane, near Irrum Manzil Metro Station, and overall, it was a delightful experience. The rooms were beautifully designed, offering a cozy and inviting ambiance that made my stay truly enjoyable.
All the amenities provided were top-notch, contributing to a comfortable and convenient stay. If you plan accordingly and buy a few groceries, you can save a lot on restaurant bills as there is a refrigerator, all necessary utensils, etc. to make you feel like you're at home.
The location of the hotel couldn't have been better for travelers like myself since the metro station is just a few clicks away, making it easy to explore the city without hassle.
However, I would like to mention a couple of considerations that future guests might find helpful. Firstly, there is no lift in the hotel, which might pose a challenge for those traveling with elderly individuals or heavy luggage. This is something to keep in mind when planning your stay.
Additionally, during my visit, there was a minor issue with a faucet in the common washroom. While it didn't significantly impact my stay, I believe it's important to mention for the sake of transparency.
Despite these minor drawbacks, my overall experience at Neem Tree was positive. The comfort and style of the rooms, along with the excellent amenities and prime location, outweighed the downsides. I would certainly consider staying here again on my next trip to Hyderabad.
Thank you to the staff at Neem Tree for their hospitality, and I hope this review helps fellow travelers make informed decisions.
